name: scsi-spike
description: Throwaway P0 spike — koffi FFI for SCSI VPD-page-0xC0 inquiry against real iPods. See doc-031.
//: Run the spikes directly with your runtime of choice — koffi works under both. Examples: `node --import tsx ./linux.ts /dev/sg3 out.xml`, `bun ./linux.ts /dev/sg3 out.xml`, `node --import tsx ./macos.ts out.xml`. Wrapping these in npm scripts pins them to one runtime, defeating the cross-runtime validation.
